# Release readiness checklist

## Product and coverage
- [ ] The intended user outcome is clear.
- [ ] High-risk paths and known changes have appropriate coverage.
- [ ] Important integrations, data, permissions, and error behavior were considered.
- [ ] Accessibility and responsive behavior were reviewed where relevant.

## Communication and recovery
- [ ] Known risks, gaps, and decisions are visible to the right people.
- [ ] Monitoring, support signals, and ownership after release are understood.
- [ ] A practical rollback or recovery approach is available if needed.

## Learning
- [ ] Follow-up checks or feedback are planned after release.
